request.initial_prompt: Very well then, let us separate the independent goods from the instrumental, and see whether they are spoken of as under one ἰδέα. But the question next arises, what kind of goods are we to call independent? All such as are pursued even when separated from other goods, as, for instance, being wise, seeing, and certain pleasures and honours (for these, though we do pursue them with some further end in view, one would still place among the independent goods)? or does it come in fact to this, that we can call nothing independent good except the ἰδέα, and so the concrete of it will be nought?

raw_segments.text: Very well then, let us separate the independent goods from the instrumental, and see whether they are spoken of as under one letter ἰδέα.

But the question next arises, what kind of goods are we to call independent? All such as are pursued even when separated from other goods, as, for instance, being wise, seeing, and certain pleasures and honours, for these, though we do pursue them with some further end in view, one would still place among the independent goods.
Or does it come in fact to this, that we can call nothing independent good except the letter ἰδέα, and so the concrete of it will be nought?
